cases.question: How do you build RAG on AWS?
cases.resume: Data Engineer, 5 years. Built CDC pipelines from Postgres into Snowflake with dbt models. Built an internal RAG assistant over Confluence pages using LangChain and pgvector. Led migration of 40 Airflow DAGs to managed Airflow on AWS (MWAA).
stories: Situation: the nightly load missed its SLA twice. Task: fix it. Action: I split the job into incremental dbt models and added freshness checks. Result: loads finished before 6am for the rest of the quarter.
